name: …Ужаса!
alt: Обычная деревянная ложка обрела зловещее сияние и пугает мышонка.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, legible at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms and strong readable silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one clear visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs or malformed objects. Subject: One ordinary oversized wooden soup spoon floating upright in a ridiculously dramatic halo of dark violet magic, with two tiny glowing red eyes appearing in the bowl of the spoon. A small loose black ribbon with skull bead tied around its handle. One tiny gray mouse below clutches a crumb and stares in comic alarm. Clear wooden spoon silhouette, no other weapons or utensils, one mouse with four paws and one tail. Warm parchment, humorous enchanted-item enhancement.
